svg.title: Glass background over a landscape
svg.desc: PofBC demonstration of the Foundation’s digital glass-background rule. Two instances of one photograph align exactly. A rounded clipping path confines a blurred copy to the panel behind the text.
svg.metadata: Playbook: https://cdn.sanity.io/images/p3hjnjl0/production/136100d9d4083a0cbd50a1a9e195e4f74e13b0c0-3300x2550.jpg. Photograph: https://cdn.sanity.io/images/p3hjnjl0/production/316790053ad6883866cf135177f05221c132ee06-1640x924.png. Editorial combination of the two references.
